cases.translation: Surely there is a mine for silver.
cases.explain: The preposition 'для' (for) governs the genitive case; 'рудник для серебра' means 'a mine for silver'.

cases.translation: Iron is taken out of the earth.
cases.explain: The verb 'добывают' (extract/mine) requires the accusative case; for neuter nouns, accusative equals nominative.

cases.translation: Copper is smelted out of the ore.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from/out of) governs the genitive case; 'из руды' means 'from the ore'.

cases.translation: Man sets an end to darkness.
cases.explain: The verb 'полагает' (sets/places) requires the accusative case; for inanimate nouns, accusative equals nominative.

cases.translation: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'роет' (digs) requires the accusative case; 'роет колодец' means 'digs a well'.

cases.translation: In places which the foot of man has forgotten.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive 'стопа человека' (the foot of man) shows possession; the genitive follows the head noun.

cases.sentence: Пути к ним не знает хищная ___.
cases.translation: That path no bird of prey knows.
cases.explain: The noun птица (bird) is the subject of the verb 'знает' (knows); nominative case marks the subject.

cases.translation: He puts his hand upon the flinty rock.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with the meaning of 'upon' governs the accusative case; 'на гранит' means 'on(to) granite'.

reading.ru: Есть рудник для серебра, и для золота есть горн плавильный. Из земли добывают железо и плавит медь из руды.
reading.question: What does the passage say about sources of precious metals and minerals?
options: There is a mine for silver and a furnace for gold; iron is extracted from earth and copper is smelted from ore
The earth provides unlimited gold and silver to those who work hard
Gold and silver are more valuable than iron and copper
Precious metals are only found in deep caves and mountains
reading.correct: There is a mine for silver and a furnace for gold; iron is extracted from earth and copper is smelted from ore
reading.explain: The text describes the locations and processes: 'Есть рудник для серебра, и для золота есть горн плавильный. Из земли добывают железо и плавит медь из руды'.

reading.ru: Далеко от жилья он роет колодец, в местах, что забыла стопа человека, висит он и зыблится вдали от людей.
reading.question: Where does the miner dig and what is his condition?
options: Far from settlements he digs wells in remote places, where he hangs and sways away from people
He digs near villages to provide water for people
He works in comfortable mines close to his home
He digs in deep caves where no one can see him
reading.correct: Far from settlements he digs wells in remote places, where he hangs and sways away from people
reading.explain: The passage describes the miner's isolated work: 'Далеко от жилья он роет колодец, в местах, что забыла стопа человека, висит он и зыблится вдали от людей'.

reading.ru: Земля, на которой вырастает пища, изнутри изрыта будто огнем, сапфиров россыпь в ее камнях, и в ней золотой песок.
reading.question: What treasures does the earth contain according to this passage?
options: Food grows on earth's surface while sapphires and golden sand lie within
All the earth's wealth is hidden deep underground forever
The earth is barren except for what people cultivate
Precious stones are scattered everywhere on the earth's surface
reading.correct: Food grows on earth's surface while sapphires and golden sand lie within
reading.explain: The passage describes what the earth yields: 'Земля, на которой вырастает пища, изнутри изрыта...сапфиров россыпь в ее камнях, и в ней золотой песок'.

reading.ru: Но где можно найти мудрость, где обитает разум? Не знает смертный ее дома, на земле живых ее не найти?
reading.question: What profound question does Job ask about wisdom?
options: Where can wisdom be found and where does understanding dwell; man does not know its dwelling place
Is wisdom found in books and teachings of the wise
Can a man become wise through wealth and power
Is wisdom inherited from one's ancestors
reading.correct: Where can wisdom be found and where does understanding dwell; man does not know its dwelling place
reading.explain: The passage poses fundamental questions about wisdom: 'Но где можно найти мудрость, где обитает разум? Не знает смертный ее дома'.

reading.ru: Пучина скажет, во мне ее нет, и мол, ведь море не у меня она.
reading.question: What do the deep and the sea declare about wisdom?
options: Neither the deep nor the sea possess wisdom
Wisdom is hidden in the depths of the ocean
Sailors can find wisdom by traveling the seas
The ocean guards the secrets of wisdom
reading.correct: Neither the deep nor the sea possess wisdom
reading.explain: The personified deep and sea deny having wisdom: 'Пучина скажет, во мне ее нет, и мол...море не у меня она'.

reading.ru: Только Бог знает пути мудрости. Только Богу ведом к ней путь, Он знает ее жилище, ведь Он озирает края земли и видит все, что под небесами.
reading.question: According to this passage, who alone knows the path to wisdom?
options: Only God knows the ways of wisdom and its dwelling place; He sees the ends of the earth and all under heaven
The wise men of the earth know the path to wisdom
Angels and spirits know the path to wisdom but don't reveal it
Philosophers and scholars have discovered the path to wisdom
reading.correct: Only God knows the ways of wisdom and its dwelling place; He sees the ends of the earth and all under heaven
reading.explain: The passage affirms God's unique knowledge: 'Только Бог знает пути мудрости...Он озирает края земли и видит все, что под небесами'.
